name: Ballpit
author: E. T. Carter
description: A frame packed edge to edge with shaded spheres at four depths: far ones small, crisp and fogged, near ones large and soft-focused. Every sphere carries a real material, wrapped diffuse, a tight specular, a lit rim, self-shading toward the limb and a contact occlusion ring on whatever sits behind it, and the whole pit drifts and wobbles slowly as if settling.

params.label: Drift
params.effect: Drift and wobble speed of the pit; 0 holds every sphere still.

params.label: Packing
params.effect: Sphere size against its slot; low leaves gaps between spheres, high jams them into heavy overlap.

params.label: Soft focus
params.effect: Depth-of-field softness on the near layers; 0 keeps every sphere crisp.

params.label: Gloss
params.effect: Specular highlight and rim strength on every sphere.

params.label: Occlusion
params.effect: Contact occlusion between overlapping spheres; high sinks the pit into deep shadow between balls.
